acquisition method: The timsTOF Pro operated in PASEF mode, selecting precursors with charge states 0 to 5 for fragmentation and acquiring 10 PASEF-MS/MS scans per cycle.
cleavage agent: Trypsin/P was specified as the cleavage enzyme, allowing up to 2 missing cleavages.
enrichment method: Utilizing immunoprecipitation (IP) and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), a plethora of proteins were identified as putative interactors with SmD2
instrument: Peptides were analyzed using the timsTOF Pro (Bruker Daltonics)
ionization type: with a capillary source and an electrospray voltage of 1.60 kV.
labeling: An unbiased label-free quantitative proteome was employed in tumor tissues
mass analyzer: Precursors and fragments were analyzed at the TOF detector with an MS/MS scan range of 100–1700 m/z.
precursor tolerance: Mass tolerances for precursor and fragment ions were set to 20 ppm (first search), 5 ppm (main search), and 0.02 Da, respectively.
fragment tolerance: Mass tolerances for precursor and fragment ions were set to 20 ppm (first search), 5 ppm (main search), and 0.02 Da, respectively.
